gen.title: How poverty status is determined step by step
gen.orderNote: Steps are numbered in the source example

steps.label: Assign poverty threshold to family
steps.quote: The Census Bureau assigns each person or family one out of 48 possible poverty thresholds.

steps.label: Identify yearly threshold for household
steps.quote: Step 1: Determine the family’s poverty threshold for that year

steps.label: Add up incomes of family members
steps.quote: Step 2: Calculate the total family income for the same year

steps.label: Compare income to threshold value
steps.quote: Step 3: Compare the family’s total income with the poverty threshold

steps.label: Decide poverty status from comparison
steps.quote: Since Family A’s total income was greater than their poverty threshold, they are not considered “in poverty” according to the official definition.
